besluite.fout: 'voordat daar 'n enjin was' is vague and can be read as engines not existing yet, while the paragraph means the brothers' own machine had none
besluite.rede: Same people, same time and same action; the proposal states plainly what the paragraph means, adds no fact and touches no protected wording.

besluite.fout: With a definite object, 'nie' before 'daardie vlugte' reads like English word order and blurs that 'lank' is what is negated
besluite.rede: Natural Afrikaans places 'nie' after the definite object, so the negation falls on 'lank'; the meaning and the next sentence's 'wel' contrast stay intact.
